claim_scope: The Hasse--Witt zero scheme on the smooth normalized Ciani coefficient space in characteristic five is reduced finite etale of degree eight, with four closed points of degree two.
scientific_integrity: All coefficients and field computations are explicit; finite enumeration corroborates but does not replace the algebraic exhaustiveness proof.
scientific_limitations: Not a count of isomorphism classes or a claim about the entire genus-three moduli stack. Brock (1993) full text not available for comparison; historical priority remains provisional.
title: The characteristic-five Ciani superspecial parameter scheme consists of four quadratic points
